stem:
A sidewalk in the shape of two triangles, a rectangle, and a square was built around the edge of a building as shown.

What is the area of the sidewalk in square feet?
visual_elements: Diagram of a sidewalk shape consisting of two triangles, one rectangle, and one square with these dimensions: 18 ft horizontal length at top, 6 ft vertical heights in triangles and square, and 30 ft total length at bottom.
